rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance / Human Rights Ordinance: source of income as a protected category
rules.requirement: Source of income, including Section 8 and public benefits, is a protected category under the Cambridge Human Rights Ordinance and the Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance. Housing discrimination against applicants based on source of income is therefore prohibited.

coverage.summary: The FAQ page describes protected categories generally, including housing. It states no unit-count or building-type limits.

rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
rules.review_note: The source is a Cambridge Human Rights Commission FAQ page. It does not give the code section, adoption date, or any criminal-history or credit screening rules, so the section citation is unconfirmed.
rules.source_notes: Secondary description of the ordinances. The passage names the ordinances but not their section numbers.
